Cal.diy uses the related Cal.com mark; MariaDB Operator uses the MariaDB technology mark. Other downloaded logos match the named service. Neutral symbols are original SVGs, not product logos.

Skills logos added October 25, 2026: Kubernetes, Proxmox, Talos, OpenTofu, and Ansible from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/<name>.svg`; Argo CD reuses `argo-cd.svg`. Debian uses `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/selfhst/icons/svg/debian.svg`. selfh.st collection: https://github.com/selfhst/icons (CC BY 4.0; see LICENSE-selfhst); marks remain property of their respective owners. Downloaded artwork is unchanged.

Emiliany logo supplied by the user as `emiliany-logo.svg`, copied to `assets/emiliany/logo.svg`. Antalos artwork copied unchanged from the owning repository’s `site/public/favicon.svg` to `assets/antalos.svg`; the supplied Windows Y: path was inaccessible in this environment.
